participant_profile: 18–30, uses at least one digital banking app weekly; no real financial data required
primary_question: Can people correctly interpret Money Horizon and decide what is safe to spend without confusing forecasted or committed money with immediately spendable funds?
allowed_claims: A moderated usability study has been designed
The current product thesis remains a hypothesis
forbidden_claims_until_verified: Nova has been validated by users
Any conversion, retention, adoption or business impact claim
promotion_rule: Change evidence_state to VERIFIED only after anonymized session records exist, the evidence register references them, and synthesis separates observations from interpretations.
